displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E08
meaning: Flame current is low, but still strong enough to allow operation.
causes: Low flame current while the furnace is still allowed to run
diySteps: The furnace may still heat. Write down E08 before it is cleared
Technician: measure flame current at the flame sensor. This guide reads it on the FP pads, typically 0.75 to 3.0 microamps
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician to measure and correct the low flame current before it becomes a lockout.
